about.title: Who We Are
about.subtitle: The minds, mission, and vision driving our journey.
about.quote: "Every child in Nepal deserves a safe environment, quality education, and the opportunity to build a self-reliant future."
about.badgeText: Transparent operations focused on child welfare
about.headline: Transforming Lives Through Education, Health & Compassion in Nepal
about.p1: is a grassroots non-profit organization established to break the cycle of poverty and hardship for vulnerable children and rural communities across Nepal. We operate on the conviction that real social change starts when a child is supported holistically—spiritually, intellectually, and physically.
about.p2: By partnering directly with local schools, healthcare professionals, and village leaders, we bridge critical resource gaps. From distributing essential learning materials and funding scholarships to hosting health camps and providing nutritional support, our initiatives ensure that no child is left behind due to economic hardship.

pillars.title: Child Education & Literacy
pillars.text: Providing scholarships, classroom supplies, school infrastructure repairs, and digital learning tools to empower young minds across rural Nepal.

pillars.title: Healthcare & Nutrition
pillars.text: Conducting rural health checkups, hygiene awareness workshops, and nutritional meal support programs for growing children.

pillars.title: Community Protection
pillars.text: Working alongside families to build safe spaces, foster child protection awareness, and deliver emergency relief during local crises.

about.missionText: To eliminate poverty barriers by delivering equal access to quality education, essential healthcare services, and protective social environments for underprivileged children throughout Nepal.
about.visionText: A resilient Nepal where every child—regardless of gender or socio-economic background—grows up healthy, well-educated, and fully equipped to build a self-reliant future.
